title: Dark Neck Skincare: A Gentle Routine for a More Even-Looking Neck
ex: Why the neck can look darker than the face, a gentle morning and night routine, helpful ingredients, and signs that mean you should see a doctor.
rt: Dark Neck Skincare: A Gentle Daily Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Dark neck skincare: why the neck looks darker, a gentle morning and night routine with sunscreen, helpful ingredients, and when to see a doctor first.
quick: For a dull, darker-looking neck, wash gently without scrubbing, moisturise daily, carry your face cream down to the neck and wear sunscreen on it every morning. Give it 8–12 weeks. If the neck folds darken suddenly or feel velvety, see a doctor, as it can be linked to blood sugar or hormones.
facts: The neck gets daily sun but often misses sunscreen.
Friction from collars and jewellery can make the neck look darker.
Neck skin is thinner, so actives can sting more.
Sudden velvety darkening in neck folds is a reason to see a doctor.
